本机 C++ 服务不可用，请重新启动终端: Local C++ service unavailable. Restart Terminal.
请在 Asterion Terminal 桌面应用中打开: Open this in the Asterion Terminal desktop app
本机核心返回了不支持的状态契约: The local core returned an unsupported state contract
安装包未提供初始化脚本: The installer does not contain the initialization script
保存失败，请检查本机存储权限。: Save failed. Check local storage permissions.
节点配置无法读取，原始内容未改写。请修复配置后重新打开设置。: Cannot read node profiles. The original data is unchanged. Repair the configuration and reopen Settings.
无法访问剪贴板，请手动复制上方公钥: Clipboard unavailable. Copy the public key above manually.
初始化脚本已导出，请复制到目标 Linux 并由管理员执行: Initialization script exported. Copy it to the target Linux machine for an administrator to run.
防火墙已启用，专用账户仅有查询权限，请管理员放行此来源和端口: Firewall enabled. This account has read-only access; ask an administrator to allow this source and port.
需要管理员或免交互 sudo 权限: Administrator or noninteractive sudo permission required
防火墙未启用，保持现状，请管理员确认网络策略: Firewall disabled. No change will be made; ask an administrator to review network policy.
当前防火墙尚不支持自动配置，请管理员手动放行此来源和端口: Automatic configuration is unavailable for this firewall. Ask an administrator to allow this source and port.
此平台需手动配置来源 IP 与端口规则: Configure source IP and port rules manually on this platform
本系统记录的规则已撤销: The rule recorded by Asterion has been removed
规则已执行；请安装并连接服务管理器后确认心跳。: Rule applied. Install and connect the Service Manager to verify its heartbeat.
规则已执行，但 TCP/mTLS 仍不可达。请检查服务监听、云安全组、路由器或其: Rule applied, but TCP/mTLS is still unreachable. Check service listeners, cloud security groups, routers and other network policies.
没有可执行的规则变更，请检查本系统是否拥有该规则。: No rule change is available. Check whether Asterion owns the rule.
确认仅对上述来源和端口操作；五分钟后或目标状态变化后需要重新检查。只管理 Ast: Confirm changes only for this source and port. Inspect again after five minutes or a target state change. Only rules recorded by Asterion are managed.
本机服务管理器尚未就绪，请重试启动: Local Service Manager is not ready. Retry startup.
操作与当前状态冲突: The operation conflicts with the current state.
本机行情服务尚未就绪，请重试启动: The local market service is not ready. Retry startup.
本机研究服务尚未就绪，请重试启动: The local research service is not ready. Retry startup.
先停止服务（会中断连接与任务），再更新程序。保留配置与数据，更新后需手动启动。: Stop the service first, interrupting connections and tasks, then update its programs. Configuration and data remain. Start it manually afterwards.
开发环境不管理系统安装: System installation is not managed in development
尚未安装本机服务管理器: Local Service Manager is not installed
安装包中有不同版本: This package contains a different build
无法检查本机服务管理器程序: Unable to inspect the local Service Manager program
后台组件更新状态异常，请查看详情: Background component update state is invalid. See details.
后台组件更新尚未完成，请重试启动: Background component update is incomplete. Retry startup.
无法确认当前服务状态: Current service status could not be confirmed
当前通过安装包更新: Updates are currently installed using the installer
更新会等待服务安全停止，并在完成后恢复原运行状态；无法安全停止的业务会阻止更新。: Updates wait for services to stop safely, then restore their prior running state. Work that cannot stop safely blocks the update.
服务已停止，可以修改插件清单。: Service stopped. You can edit its plugin selection.
先停止服务及下载任务，再修改插件清单。: Stop the service and its downloads before changing plugins.
服务配置已变化，请重新载入后选择插件。: Service configuration changed. Reload before selecting plugins.
插件配置已保存，启动服务后生效。: Plugin configuration saved. Start the service to apply it.
插件目录表示可部署的版本；每个服务使用自己保存的启用清单。: The directory lists deployable versions. Each service uses its own saved selection.
插件目录中没有动态库。: No dynamic libraries in the plugin directory.
连接保存凭据策略与请求上限；合约、日期和周期由下载任务选择。: Connections store credential preferences and request limits. Each download selects its contract, dates and interval.
凭据仅在本次运行中使用: Credential used only during this run
数据源插件未启用: Data source plugin is not enabled
凭据留空表示保留；已提交的任务不受连接修改影响。: Leave the credential blank to keep it. Editing a connection does not change submitted tasks.
验证成功表示接口接受请求，不保证所选时段有数据。删除连接不删除已提交任务或历史数: Successful verification means the API accepted the request; it does not guarantee data for a period. Deleting a connection keeps submitted tasks and historical data.
我信任此动态库的来源；读取插件信息会执行其本机代码。: I trust this library. Inspecting it executes its native code.
安装后为服务选择版本并保存。每个服务只能启用同一插件的一个版本。: After installation, select and save a version for the service. Each service can enable one version of each plugin.
仅移除可部署副本；已部署服务、任务和历史数据保留。: Remove the deployable copy only. Deployed services, tasks and historical data are retained.
当前管理本机研究服务的原生插件；可复用凭据在连接页面配置。: Manage native plugins for the local research service. Configure reusable credentials on the Connections page.
连接文件无法读取，已保留原文件供检查: This connection file cannot be read; it is kept for inspection
研究服务未连接，无法读取已下载的历史数据。: The research service is not connected, so downloaded history is unavailable.
还没有已完成的历史下载。请先在数据页从数据源下载分钟线或日线。: No completed history downloads yet. Download minute or daily bars from a data source on the Data page first.
需要同一合约的日线下载: Requires a daily download of the same contract
先填写全部保证金与手续费: Fill in all margin and fee fields first
日线中有 {n} 个交易日没有分钟数据：{days}: {n} trading days in the daily data have no minute bars: {days}
组合最多 {n} 个合约。: A portfolio holds at most {n} contracts.
交易日区间留空表示全部；组合内合约须覆盖相同交易日；合约单位以交易所公布为准。: Leave the trading-day range empty for all days; portfolio contracts must cover the same trading days; contract units follow the exchange.
费率模板格式无效，原数据未改动。: Invalid fee template format. Stored data was not changed.
请填写有效的费率、来源和生效日期。: Enter valid rates, a source and an effective date.
同一生效日期已存在费率版本，不会覆盖。: A version already exists for this effective date. It will not be overwritten.
费率版本最多 512 个。: At most 512 cost versions are allowed.
费率版本未覆盖首个交易日 {day}: Cost versions do not cover the first trading day {day}
按交易日使用固定的费率版本；更改模板不影响本次配置。: Pinned cost versions apply by trading day. Template edits do not change this configuration.
固定费率假设：以下数值适用于全部所选交易日。: Fixed-cost assumption: these values apply to every selected trading day.
{service} 已部署，当前运行位置未改变。请在服务就绪后选择使用。: {service} is deployed. Your active connection has not changed. Select it once it is ready.
仅支持 Linux x86_64。添加机器不会改变当前运行位置。: Linux x86_64 only. Adding a machine does not change your active connections.
仅更新此服务的程序，保留配置和数据；完成后仍保持停止。: Update this service's programs, preserving configuration and data. It remains stopped afterwards.
使用所选私钥对应的公钥初始化目标机器，下一步只在本机输入私钥。: Initialize the machine with the public key matching your private key. Enter the private key locally in the next step.
使用管理员提供的主机指纹核验 known_hosts。未知或变化的主机身份会被拒: Verify known_hosts against the host fingerprint supplied by your administrator. Unknown or changed identities are rejected.
停止交易服务不会自动撤销柜台委托，请先在账户中核对委托与持仓。: Stopping trading does not cancel broker orders. Check orders and positions in the account first.
关闭 Terminal 不会停止服务。部署新服务不会自动切换当前连接。: Services continue after Terminal closes. Deploying a service does not switch your active connection.
创建账户、策略或任务后自动启动: Starts automatically when you create an account, strategy or task
只切换此功能的连接。原服务继续运行，已有数据和任务不会搬到目标机器。: Only this feature's connection changes. The original service continues running; existing data and tasks stay where they are.
只检查当前机器的管理端口；规则变更需要单独确认。: Inspect this machine's management port. Rule changes require a separate confirmation.
安装后仅连接机器。下一步再选择部署哪些服务。: Installation connects the machine. Choose which services to deploy afterwards.
将先断开当前账户连接；若目标连接失败，需要手动重新连接。不会重发交易命令。: The current account connection will close first. If the new connection fails, reconnect manually. Trading commands are never resent.
将公钥和初始化脚本交给目标机器的管理员。私钥始终留在本机。: Give the public key and initialization script to the machine administrator. The private key stays on this Mac.
尚未部署服务。添加服务后，本机运行不受影响。: No services deployed. Adding a service leaves local services running.
已通过可信渠道核对主机指纹: I verified the host fingerprint through a trusted channel
当前未连接此服务，无法核实完整业务活动；请先查看账户或任务。: This service is not currently connected, so full activity cannot be verified. Review its account or tasks first.
暂无服务，请检查本机启动状态。: No services. Check local startup status.
机器名称已存在，请从机器列表继续配置。: This machine name already exists. Continue setup from the machine list.
正在刷新状态，暂不能执行服务操作。: Refreshing status. Service actions are temporarily unavailable.
此服务的连接会中断，运行中的任务可能中断。其他机器不会被停止。: Connections to this service will close and running tasks may be interrupted. Other machines will not be stopped.
每个服务拥有独立数据目录；研究服务包含回测、因子与下载工作程序。: Each service has its own data directory. Research includes backtest, factor and download workers.
目标状态已变化，请取消后重新检查。: The target has changed. Cancel and review its current state.
管理员在目标机器执行: The administrator runs on the target machine
脚本创建专用账户并输出主机指纹。它不会安装业务服务或自动开放端口。: The script creates a dedicated account and prints the host fingerprint. It does not install business services or open ports automatically.
节点失联，以下是最后确认的状态。不会自动切换或重发命令。: The machine is unreachable. These are its last confirmed states. No automatic switching or command resending occurs.
选择一台机器查看服务，或添加远程机器。: Select a machine to view services, or add a remote machine.
选择目标机器可用的 TCP 端口。部署前会校验名称、端口和内置程序。: Choose an available TCP port on the machine. The service name, port and bundled programs are validated before deployment.
默认在本机运行。仅在需要时添加远程 Linux。: Runs locally by default. Add a remote Linux machine only when needed.
远程研究连接已断开，当前运行位置保持不变。: The remote research connection is offline. The selected location is unchanged.
下载来源不属于当前研究服务，请重新选择数据。: This download does not belong to the selected research service. Select its data again.
已匹配同一合约的日线结算版本。: A daily settlement version for this contract has been selected.
存在多个日线版本，请明确选择本次使用的结算来源。: Multiple daily versions exist. Select the settlement version for this run.
数据版本不属于当前研究服务，请重新选择数据。: This data version does not belong to the current research service. Select data again.
需要同一合约的日线数据: Daily data for the same contract is required
历史仓库还没有数据。请先在数据页下载分钟线或日线。: The historical archive is empty. Download minute or daily data on the Data page.
使用后替换当前选择，已有任务不受影响。: Using this dataset replaces the current selection. Existing tasks are unchanged.
保存合约、区间、计量参数和固定数据版本；同名不同输入另存为独立版本。: Saves contracts, dates, units and fixed data versions. Different inputs under the same name create a separate version.
数据集已保存，可在当前研究服务中重复使用。: Dataset saved for reuse on this research service.
选择同合约、同周期的其他下载；相同记录去重，冲突记录拒绝使用。每类最多 32 份: Choose other downloads of the same contract and interval. Identical rows are deduplicated; conflicting rows are rejected. Up to 32 versions per role.
结算日历中有 {n} 个交易日没有 K 线：{days}: The settlement calendar has {n} trading days without bars: {days}
插件 {p0} 无法加载，可在设置的插件页查看原因: Plugin {p0} cannot be loaded. See the reason on the Plugins page in Settings.
{p0} 项任务上次被中断，可在任务中心重试: {p0} tasks were interrupted last time. Retry them in the Task Center.
应用自带的插件始终启用；自行安装的插件可以选择是否启用。: Plugins shipped with the application are always enabled. Plugins you install are optional.
macOS Terminal 使用当前系统账户自动运行服务管理器，无需 SSH、: macOS Terminal runs the Service Manager under your system account, without SSH keys or a machine initializer. Opening a CTP trading account starts its trading service on demand.
此合约缺少日线结算数据，补齐后才能用于回测。: This contract has no daily settlement data. Add it before using the contract in a backtest.
已开通交易，经纪商代码、投资者账号、AppID 和交易前置不能修改。: Trading is set up; the broker ID, investor ID, AppID and trade front cannot be changed.
